# Netsidian 0.6.1

- MCP guidance now tells agents to maintain one Markdown note per topic for human readers, preserve sources and edits, and skip writes when nothing changed. If an agent also needs a memory entry, it should link to the note instead of duplicating facts that can change.
- Search now finds technical names such as `config/links.json` when they appear in inline code. Tags and links written inside inline code remain literal text.
- Click the ribbon logo to open About and see the version, release date, source repository, and release notes.

## Upgrade

Back up the SQLite database and document storage before upgrading. Migration 0011 marks existing documents for a one-time search index refresh in the background. It does not alter Markdown or create new document revisions. Inline code in older notes becomes searchable as the refresh completes.

## Downloads

Choose the archive for Windows x64, Linux x64, macOS Intel, or macOS Apple Silicon. See the instructions included in the archive. Verify the download against `SHA256SUMS`.

The Linux container is `ghcr.io/pentaqilo/netsidian:0.6.1`. The Helm chart is `netsidian-0.6.1.tgz`, and `docker-image.txt` records the image digest.
